name: Nexo ARG for WooCommerce
author: Francisco José Arioli

sections.description:
Nexo ARG es el ERP para WooCommerce pensado para Argentina: una solución integral, todo en español. Gestioná mejor tus ventas online: productos, stock, pedidos, fotos, correo y seguridad desde un panel pensado para vender en Argentina, con una tienda que abre al instante. Gratis, sin registro ni tarjeta. Y cuando lo necesitás, le sumás de a uno los complementos: facturación electrónica ARCA (ex AFIP), Mercado Libre con stock sincronizado, cobros online con Mercado Pago, MODO y cuotas, envíos con Correo Argentino, SEO y Google.

  • Inventario y stock de todo el catálogo en una sola tabla, con planilla para Excel.
  • Pedidos con estados claros (por pagar, pagado, para despachar, despachado, entregado), remito y pedidos cargados a mano.
  • Promociones automáticas (2×1, por cantidad, por categoría) y cupones.
  • Reportes de ventas por período, producto, medio de pago y provincia.
  • Tienda rápida: caché de páginas y fotos en WebP.
  • Cuenta del cliente, mails en castellano desde tu casilla, login protegido y botón de WhatsApp.

Más información y documentación en arioli.dev.

In English

Nexo ARG for WooCommerce is an all-in-one ERP for WooCommerce built for Argentina, in Spanish (ARCA invoicing, Mercado Pago, Mercado Libre, Correo Argentino, Argentine VAT and pesos): it replaces a long list of small plugins with one panel. It works on top of WooCommerce and your theme (classic or block based) and only uses the standard WordPress and WooCommerce APIs.

Free, no registration, no license key required:

  • Products – stock, price, sale price (with dates) and status of the whole catalog in one table, edited inline. Guided product creation with photos, sizes and colors. Spreadsheet export/import for bulk changes. Back-in-stock requests.
  • Catalog – categories, brands, tags and attributes (size, color) in one place.
  • Orders – all orders with clear statuses (awaiting payment, unpaid, paid, ready to ship, shipped with tracking, delivered), notes and a printable packing slip. Unpaid orders are released automatically after a configurable time. Manual payment confirmation (bank transfer / cash) with proof upload.
  • Images – every new image is optimized automatically on upload: oversized photos are resized, every size is compressed and gets a WebP copy that the store shows instead of the JPG/PNG (by rewriting image URLs, so it works on any host without server rules). Lazy loading for images below the fold. Existing images are completed with one click and keep going in the background. Originals are kept so you can restore them. Works with Imagick or GD when the host blocks exec (no pngquant/cwebp needed).
  • Speed & cache – page cache built for WooCommerce: cart, checkout, my account and any visitor with items in the cart or logged in never get a cached page, and every product, stock, price, category, menu or theme change clears exactly what shows it and re-caches it in the background. Header cart without extra requests, browser cache rules (.htaccess on Apache, copy-paste rules for nginx), optional Cloudflare integration (automatic purge, a cache rule that caches store pages safely and recommended zone settings) and a speed check that measures the store like a visitor.
  • My Account – a redesigned customer account: summary, orders with explained statuses and timeline, tracking and printable receipt.
  • Email – send through your own SMTP, edit sender and the text of every customer email with preview.
  • Coupons & promotions – automatic promotions applied in the cart without a code (percentage, N or more units, buy N pay M) by product, category and dates, plus the WooCommerce coupons managed from the same screen.
  • Sales reports – sales by period with comparison, by product, category, payment method, delivery, status, province and customer.
  • Promo bar – a top bar that rotates or scrolls your own messages (and, with add-ons, installments and free-shipping rules).
  • Contact – floating WhatsApp button (the customer starts the chat) and contact forms with bot protection.
  • Login security – branded login page, custom login URL and Cloudflare Turnstile verification.
  • Guides – every screen has a built-in guide that tells you what is missing and marks what is done.
  • Chatia – connect your own Chatia account (an Arioli.dev product, sold separately) and its assistant answers WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger with real store data (products, sizes, the customer’s own orders and tracking); your team replies from the same panel. The module itself is free.
  • Error log – a Registro screen records plugin errors (failed panel actions, emails that could not be sent, ARCA, Chatia, updates and PHP notices from the plugin’s own files) with date, origin and detail; the Home screen warns when there were errors in the last 24 hours, and “Copy for support” prepares a report.

Paid add-ons (optional) are sold separately at arioli.dev and delivered by the companion plugin Addons Nexo ARG for WooCommerce: online payments (Mercado Pago, MODO, Nave, Payway, Getnet, Openpay, GOcuotas), shipping and Correo Argentino, ARCA electronic invoicing, Mercado Libre, SEO and Google tools, catalog filters and color swatches, size guides, resellers, returns, customer management, product feeds and Instagram/Facebook feeds. The free plugin is fully functional without any add-on; add-ons are enabled with a single license key entered under Nexo ARG › License.

The interface is in Spanish (Argentina), the language of the stores it is built for.

External services

The free plugin connects to the following third-party services only when you enable the related feature:

  • Arioli.dev license service (https://admin.arioli.dev/api/woonexo/) – only if you enter a license key for paid add-ons. It sends your license key, your site domain, an anonymous installation ID and the plugin, WordPress, WooCommerce and PHP versions, when you activate or verify the key and once a day. It does not send any customer, visitor or order data, nor the plugin’s error log (the error log stays in your site; the separate Addons plugin, if you install it, can share a summary with Arioli.dev support). Terms: https://arioli.dev/terminos – Privacy: https://arioli.dev/politica-de-privacidad
  • Cloudflare Turnstile (https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js) – only if you enable bot protection on the login page or contact forms with your own Turnstile keys. The Turnstile script is loaded from Cloudflare and the visitor’s response token is verified against Cloudflare’s API. Terms: https://www.cloudflare.com/website-terms/ – Privacy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/
  • Cloudflare API (https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/) – only if you paste a Cloudflare API token under Nexo ARG › Velocidad y caché. The plugin uses it to find your zone, purge the URLs that changed, create or remove its own cache rule and change the zone settings you choose to apply. It sends your token, your domain and the URLs of your store pages that changed; no customer or order data. Terms: https://www.cloudflare.com/website-terms/ – Privacy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/
  • Chatia (https://admin.arioli.dev/api/woonexo/chatia/activar and https://<your-account>.chatia.arioli.dev/api/integracion/v1/) – only if you connect your own Chatia account under Nexo ARG › Chatia with your Chatia license key. Activation sends the license key, your site domain, store URL and name and an anonymous installation ID. While connected, the plugin creates a read-only WooCommerce REST API key and sends it to your Chatia account so its assistant can answer about products, sizes and the customer’s own orders; the chat screens in the plugin read and send messages of your Chatia account. Disconnecting deletes the key. Terms: https://arioli.dev/terminos – Privacy: https://arioli.dev/politica-de-privacidad
  • WhatsApp (https://wa.me/) – the contact button opens a WhatsApp chat in the visitor’s browser or app with your number. No data is sent by the plugin itself. Privacy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy

No data is sent anywhere else. The plugin does not track visitors and, without a license key, does not phone home at all.

Source code and build

There is no build step. Every file in the plugin is the original, human-readable source: the PHP in src/ and templates/, the JavaScript in assets/js/ and the CSS in assets/css/ are written by hand and shipped as they are (not minified, compiled or bundled). To change something, edit those files directly.

Third-party assets included:

  • DM Sans and DM Mono fonts (assets/fonts/), by Colophon Foundry, SIL Open Font License 1.1 – https://github.com/googlefonts/dm-fonts
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin or install it from Plugins › Add New, then activate it.
  3. Open Nexo ARG in the WordPress menu. The Home screen lists what to configure first, and every screen has a Guide button.
  4. Optional: to use paid add-ons, buy them at arioli.dev, install the Addons Nexo ARG for WooCommerce plugin you receive and paste your license key under Nexo ARG › License.
sections.faq:
Is it really free?

Yes. Products, catalog, orders, images, speed & cache, customer account, email, coupons & promotions, sales reports, promo bar, contact, login security, the Chatia module and the error log are free, with no registration and no license key.

How do updates work?

Like any plugin from WordPress.org: WordPress shows the new version under Dashboard › Updates and Plugins, and you update it there (or let WordPress update it automatically). Nexo ARG does not check for updates on its own. Products, orders, settings and keys are kept.

What do the add-ons add?

Online payment gateways, shipping and Correo Argentino, ARCA e-invoicing, Mercado Libre, SEO tools, catalog filters, size guides, resellers, returns, customer tools, product feeds and Instagram/Facebook feeds. Each one is sold separately at arioli.dev and all of them share one license key.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes, with classic and block themes. The plugin uses WooCommerce hooks and templates; it does not modify your theme files.

Does it support HPOS?

Yes. The plugin only uses the WooCommerce order API, so it works with High-Performance Order Storage enabled or disabled, and with the block checkout.

Does the page cache break the cart or show old prices?

No. Pages with a cart, checkout or account, visitors with products in the cart and logged-in users are never cached, and the cached pages of a product, its categories, the shop and the home page are cleared whenever the product, its stock or its price changes. If another page-cache plugin is already installed, Nexo ARG will not install its own until you deactivate the other one.

Do I need Cloudflare?

No. The page cache works on its own. If your site already uses Cloudflare, connecting it with an API token lets the plugin purge Cloudflare automatically and, optionally, cache store pages at the edge.

Will it deactivate other plugins?

No. Nexo ARG never activates or deactivates plugins on its own. If a plugin that does the same job as a module you turned on is active (for example a contact-form or login-hiding plugin), the Home screen lists it with two buttons: «Desactivar» (deactivate it yourself, its settings are kept) or «Seguir usando los dos» (keep both; it is not suggested again).
sections.changelog:
1.8.5

  • Images: uploading a photo no longer waits for the optimization (with heavy PNG files and many image sizes the upload could exceed the hosting time limit and fail with error 504). The photo is optimized in the background a few seconds later, in batches that stay well below the time limit.

1.8.4

  • The free plugin no longer sends the error-log summary to arioli.dev: it only sends what the license check needs. The error log stays on your site (Registro screen, «Copy for support»).
  • License › «Verify now» tells the companion Addons plugin (if installed) that the license was checked, so it can look for new versions right away.
  • Hidden login: the admin, admin-ajax.php and admin-post.php paths are taken from admin_url() instead of being assumed.
  • Emails: no
  • Error log: no longer calls error_reporting(); expected failures (a damaged photo, a missing folder) are wrapped so they are not logged.
  • My Account: every block printed by the order screens is escaped with wp_kses; the return form’s script is enqueued instead of inline.
  • Product editor: the edit link uses the admin URL passed from PHP.

1.8.3

  • Coupons & promotions and Sales reports are now part of the free plugin (they were paid add-ons). Promotions and settings you already had are kept.

1.8.2

  • Requires WordPress 6.9 or newer.
  • Page cache and WebP image delivery now use the WordPress template output buffer (WordPress 6.9) instead of their own output buffers. The page cache no longer writes wp-content/advanced-cache.php or edits wp-config.php: it serves saved pages from the plugin itself. The advanced-cache.php left by earlier versions is removed automatically.
  • The free plugin no longer checks for updates or changes the WordPress updater: it is updated from WordPress.org like any other plugin.
  • Requests from the panel are sanitized before reaching each action.

1.8.1

  • Fix: uploading a payment receipt from the order page («Ya pagué») no longer fails with a fatal error.

1.8.0

  • Plugins that do the same job as a module are no longer deactivated automatically: the Home screen suggests it and you decide («Desactivar» or «Seguir usando los dos»).
  • All scripts and styles are loaded with the WordPress enqueue functions (promo bar, WhatsApp button, contact forms, back-in-stock form, printable pages).
  • Output escaping with wp_kses on every screen, and stricter sanitization of request data and nonces.
  • Longer prefixes for stored data: order statuses and meta keys are renamed once on update, with no action needed (requires Addons 1.5.0 or newer for the paid add-ons).

1.7.2

  • Chatia: chats update live without reloading (new conversations, messages and status). The open chat refreshes every few seconds.
  • Chatia: a chat opened from the store, from Chatia or from any connected system counts as read everywhere, and the unread count is shared.

1.7.1

  • Page cache: if the wp-content/cache folder is emptied by hand (FTP, hosting panel, another plugin), the cache rewrites its own settings instead of silently turning off.
  • Styles for the «What is brought and what is not» card of the ARCA history (Invoicing add-on 1.4.1).

1.7.0

  • Database: invoices record where they came from (issued with Nexo ARG or brought from the ARCA history), needed by the Invoicing add-on 1.4.0.

1.6.0

  • Orders: new «New order» to create orders by hand (sales by WhatsApp, phone or in the shop). Search customers by name, email, phone or ID number — with an account or who bought before without one — and their last address is filled in, editable, with the option to save the changes to their customer profile; or load a new customer and optionally create their account. Add products and variations by name or SKU with live stock, quantities and a special price per line; choose delivery (with editable cost), payment method, a fixed or percentage discount, the status (paid, awaiting payment, on hold), notes for the customer and internal notes, and whether to send the order email. WooCommerce creates the order, so stock, emails and automatic invoicing work as in the store.
  • «Screen» options on every Nexo ARG screen (like WordPress Screen Options): show or hide sections, single indicators and filter rows, reorder sections by dragging or with arrows, and show or hide table columns. Saved per user and per screen; «Restore» goes back to the original layout.

1.5.3

  • Error log: each entry keeps the complete error (full message, stack trace with short paths, screen, user role and versions), visible with «See the full error» and included in «Copy for support».
  • With a license key, the last errors are sent complete to arioli.dev with the license check (paths shortened; no customer data: no user names, emails or address values), so support can fix them without asking the store.
  • Updating Addons from the panel updates Nexo ARG first when it also has a new version.

1.5.2

  • Orders: with the Invoicing add-on, a new Invoicing column shows for each order the invoice type, number and date, whether the email to the customer was sent (when and to whom), was not sent or failed and why, whether the customer opened or downloaded it, credit notes, and the ARCA message when it was rejected.
  • Orders: Invoicing filter with counts (Not invoiced, Invoiced but not sent, Sent, With problems).
  • Orders: select invoiced orders whose email did not go out and send all their invoices at once.

1.5.1

  • Chatia: the Chatia menu appears only once Chatia is connected to the store. Until then it is offered in Nexo ARG › Complements («Arioli.dev add-ons»), where you hire it or connect it with your CHT- key; disconnecting takes you back there.

1.5.0

  • Email design (Mail › Design): logo at the size you choose (no more giant logos), left or centred, inside the card or on a colour band; background, card, text, button and footer colours; card width, rounded corners, shadow and border; font and text size; footer with your own text and the store details (address, phone, email, website, Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp). Live preview on desktop and phone size, a test email to yourself, and factory defaults.
  • Optional: use the same design for WooCommerce emails (order received, processing, completed…). Their content stays the same; header, colours and footer become yours. Off by default.
  • Orders: when an add-on can act on several orders at once (Invoicing), the list shows checkboxes, select-all and a bar with the selected count.
  • Error log: PHP notices that the plugin silences on purpose (for example reading a damaged image or removing a cache folder owned by another user) are no longer recorded as problems.
  • Security: no notice about missing Turnstile keys when the Security module is off.
  • Styles for the redesigned Sales screen and the invoice dialog of the add-ons.

1.4.0

  • New Orders › Statuses screen: rename every status (panel, WooCommerce and emails), set how the customer sees it in My Account, its color, its stage in the customer timeline, whether it counts as paid (custom and third-party statuses), whether it shows in the panel and whether the customer gets an email when an order enters it; reorder them; add your own statuses and delete them (their orders are moved to another status first, without emailing customers); restore factory values. Statuses registered by other plugins are listed and can be renamed and colored too.
  • Orders: the list now loads straight from WooCommerce, so stores with tens of thousands of orders no longer get “503” while Nexo ARG builds its order index. The index is completed in small time-limited batches in the background (Action Scheduler); Clients and Sales show a notice while it is not complete.
  • Error log: when the hosting cuts a panel action (503/504) the browser records it in the Registro, and the health summary is sent to arioli.dev a minute after a new error instead of only with the daily license check.

1.3.1

  • New “Nexo ARG versions” card on the Home and License screens: installed version of the free plugin and the add-ons, whether a new one is available, its changelog and an “Install” button for each, plus “Check for updates” with the time of the last check. Other screens keep the update notice at the top.

1.3.0

  • Updates with one click: the panel tells you when a new version of the free plugin or the add-ons is available, shows the changelog and installs it like the Plugins screen does, keeping all data and settings. “Check for updates” on the Home screen.
  • New Registro (error log) screen: plugin errors, failed panel actions, unsent emails, ARCA, Chatia and update failures and PHP notices from the plugin files, with date, origin and detail; the Home screen warns about errors in the last 24 hours; “Copy for support”. With a license key, a health summary (counts and last error messages, no customer data) travels with the daily license check so Arioli.dev support can help.
  • Orders: with the invoicing add-on, each order shows whether it is invoiced and whether the invoice email was sent, with CAE, “Invoice now”, “Resend by email”, “View” and “PDF” in the order panel.
  • Help, guides and readme updated to match what the plugin does.

1.2.1

  • Chatia: the Summary and Channel screens now walk you through each step (account, store data, channel, flow) and explain what a channel and a flow are, with the real channels of your Chatia account.
  • Chatia: the connected Chatia account is always visible, with “Disconnect” and the place where the license is managed; switching accounts also closes the connection in the previous account.
  • Chatia: if Chatia cannot read the store right after connecting (slow hosting), the account stays connected and you can retry from the panel.

1.2.0

  • New Chatia module (free with your own Chatia account): connect with your Chatia license key, choose the channel (WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger or web chat) and the conversation flow, and handle chats and contacts from the panel (Summary, Chats, Contacts, Stages, Reports, Channel). The store shares a read-only WooCommerce key so the assistant can answer about products, sizes, the customer’s own orders and shipment tracking.
  • New staff permission “Chat support” to answer chats without access to the rest of the store settings.
  • Chats: “Turn on alerts on this device” opens a Chatia page to receive push notifications for new messages (also with the phone locked or in another app); tapping one opens that chat in the panel.
  • Stages board: see open conversations by stage (they move automatically with the flow and the AI) and move them by hand; change a chat’s stage from the chat itself.
  • Reports: activity, conversations by status and by stage, replies per team member and new conversations per channel (7, 30 or 90 days).
  • Chats show the photos, audio, video and files customers send.
  • Replies are allowed within 24 hours of the customer’s last message; after that the chat is locked until the customer writes again (chats are not reopened from the store).
  • “More settings in Chatia”: direct links to the inbox, flows, assistant, quick replies, stages, reports and WhatsApp number setup.

1.1.1

  • The WordPress admin menu shows a single “Nexo ARG” item (one click opens the panel); screens are navigated from the panel’s own menu.

1.1.0

  • New Speed & cache module: WooCommerce-safe page cache with automatic purge and background re-cache, header cart without extra requests, browser cache rules, Cloudflare integration (with or without API token) and a speed check.
  • Images: WebP copies for every size (including existing images) and shown in the store on any host, resize of oversized existing photos, PNG compression with Imagick when exec is blocked, lazy loading, background optimization, diagnosis of what makes the store heavy, keep and restore originals.

1.0.1

  • License screen: clearer next step when paid add-ons are licensed but the companion Addons plugin is not installed yet.
  • New “Complementos” screen explaining what each paid add-on adds and how to enable it.

1.0.0

  • First public release: products, catalog, orders, images, customer account, email, promo bar, contact, login security and guides. Paid add-ons moved to the companion plugin.

Activation sends the license key, your site domain, store URL and name and an anonymous installation ID. While connected, the plugin creates a read-only WooCommerce REST API key and sends it to your Chatia account so its assistant can answer about products, sizes and the customer’s own orders; the chat screens in the plugin read and send messages of your Chatia account. Disconnecting deletes the key. Terms: https://arioli.dev/terminos – Privacy: https://arioli.dev/politica-de-privacidad
  • WhatsApp (https://wa.me/) – the contact button opens a WhatsApp chat in the visitor’s browser or app with your number. No data is sent by the plugin itself. Privacy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy

No data is sent anywhere else. The plugin does not track visitors and, without a license key, does not phone home at all.

Source code and build

There is no build step. Every file in the plugin is the original, human-readable source: the PHP in src/ and templates/, the JavaScript in assets/js/ and the CSS in assets/css/ are written by hand and shipped as they are (not minified, compiled or bundled). To change something, edit those files directly.
